doc.title: Hide Tanaka interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014

title: Walking through snow with the bass, and goodbyes
summary: Cab drivers won't pick up a bass player in the snow so he walked 40 minutes; Rowe thanks him and closes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Right. Well this has been a fascinating conversation. I want to thank you for joining me. Oh, your story about being covered with snow walking — what part of the city were you in?
Why won’t a cab driver pick up a bass player on those kinds of nights?

Because they are busy with just ordinary people. Why — they are so much busy, and to stop for the bass player with a soaked up bass and snow and everything inside the car. They don’t want to bother. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -12-
How many blocks did you have to walk that night?
40 minutes. Covered with snow. Again, paying dues, right? Well thanks for your time today. I look forward to your concert tonight.
All right. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -13-
